abi.decoder: agentic_sim.telemetry.bpf_work.BpfWorkCollector._event_row; same v3 packet decoder used by iter_bpf_events

feature_contract.operation: syscall number + decoder syscall name + BPF kind name from entry/event identity
feature_contract.path_class: lexical class from bounded path bytes copied by sys_enter; unknown/truncated retained explicitly
feature_contract.requested_size: decoder scalar_args.requested_size from raw syscall-entry arguments only

optional_predictions.default: disabled to avoid a giant JSON export

provenance.raw_hash_policy: collector-recorded raw_event_stream_sha256 retained; binary framing/count streamed and checked without a second full-file hash pass

selection.policy: ascending queue ordinal, evidence-valid train_calibration cases, first four distinct instance IDs; no target/outcome ranking

target_contract.clock: kernel CLOCK_MONOTONIC / bpf_ktime_get_ns; preserved separately from host CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW action anchors
target_contract.failure_targets: included when duration is positive; failure status is not a feature
target_contract.target: positive BPF kernel duration_ns for each completed individual event
target_contract.zero_or_censored_policy: positive-duration metrics exclude zero and censored targets; known fork/clone/thread lineage zeros are reported separately; any zero-duration individual operation remains in the required gate and passes only with an exact-zero prediction; censored/negative targets remain required unsupported records; nothing is imputed
